scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd apps/api test:unit && bun run --cwd apps/web test:unit
